newsitem.title: USA: Digital Equipment names new head in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Digital Equipment names new head in Europe.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp said on Thursday it named Hans Dirkmann president of the company's European operations in Geneva, Switzerland.

Chairman Robert Palmer said in a statement Dirkmann, 55, had nearly 25 years of sales and management experience at Digital Equipment. Previously, he was managing director of Digital Germany and also responsible for Austria, Central and Eastern Europe, the company said. He was named vice president for Digital Europe in 1995.
Dirkmann replaced Vincenzo Damiani, who announced his retirement last week, the company said.
The company said nearly 43 percent its revenues came from Europe.
